ai.title: Add cli-ui-tester agent and tmux helper scripts
ai.summary: New `@cli-ui-tester` agent and `scripts/tmux/` helper suite enable automated CLI UI verification via tmux. Scripts wrap input in bracketed paste mode (`\e[200~...\e[201~`) to prevent character dropping caused by OpenTUI's rapid key processing, and save session logs to `debug/tmux-sessions/`. `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/strings.ts` updated to inject full `spawnerPrompt` descriptions for spawnable agents instead of just IDs. Covers CLI tooling, agent runtime templates, and documentation.

eli5.text: After someone changes how the CLI looks on screen, there's a new automated helper that can open a real terminal window, type commands into it, and take screenshots of what actually appears. This catches visual problems that normal tests miss, like text getting cut off or layout looking wrong. The helper automatically saves full logs of every test session so developers can review exactly what the terminal showed. It's live today and ready to use right now.

ai.title: Add PageUp/PageDown keyboard shortcuts for scrolling chat history
ai.summary: PageUp/PageDown keys now scroll chat history in the CLI. Dispatches `scroll-up`/`scroll-down` actions via `resolveChatKeyboardAction`, triggering `scrollUp`/`scrollDown` callbacks in `useChatScrollbox`. Scroll amount is 80% of viewport height (`PAGE_SCROLL_FRACTION = 0.8`). Affects `cli/src/chat.tsx`, `cli/src/hooks/use-chat-keyboard.ts`, `cli/src/hooks/use-scroll-management.ts`, `cli/src/utils/keyboard-actions.ts`.

eli5.text: You can now press PageUp and PageDown to quickly scroll through your chat history in the CLI, jumping by about 80% of your visible window each time. Previously, you had to rely on scrollbar controls; now these dedicated keys send scroll commands that move the view up or down in chunks. The feature is live today: when you hit either key, the chat pane jumps as expected, and the oldest and newest messages still behave normally when you reach either end.

ai.title: Fix Anthropic token counting for image parts
ai.summary: Updated `convertContentToAnthropic` in `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts` to correctly handle both URL and base64 image sources. The function now checks the `image` field for http/https prefixes to emit `type: 'url'` sources, falling back to `type: 'base64'` for raw data. Images without valid data are skipped. Functions `convertToAnthropicMessages`, `convertContentToAnthropic`, and `formatToolContent` were exported for testing.

eli5.text: The internal system that estimates how much a task will cost has been corrected so that images sent to Anthropic's models are counted correctly. Previously, images had to be sent as base64-encoded data, but now the system also recognizes regular web links (URLs) to images. If an image doesn't have valid data or a proper web address, it is ignored entirely instead of causing errors. This fix is part of an internal token-counting tool and improves the accuracy of cost estimates before you actually run the task.

ai.title: Add tmux-viewer TUI for CLI session inspection
ai.summary: New `scripts/tmux/tmux-viewer` package provides an interactive TUI for viewing tmux session logs. Supports replay mode, GIF export via `canvas`/`gif-encoder-2`, and JSON output for AI consumption. `validate-cli-with-tmux.sh` now delegates session creation to `tmux-start.sh`.

eli5.text: If you have ever needed to inspect or replay an automated test that ran inside a special terminal session, you can now open those saved sessions in a new browser-based viewer that lets you watch them back, scroll through the full log, or export a small animated movie of the screen. you also has a hidden mode that hands the same session data to an AI as plain text. The script that starts those sessions was also simplified so it can be reused by other tools. Anyone running the command-line test suite today can launch you with a single command and immediately see interactive or exported playback.

ai.title: Support allMessages and structuredOutput in spawn agent results
ai.summary: Added handling for allMessages and structuredOutput modes in extractSpawnAgentResultContent. This fixes researcher-web result display where final content was previously ignored. updateSpawnAgentBlocks now prioritizes extracted content over streamed text if the extracted content is more substantial. Changes affect cli/src/utils/message-block-helpers.ts and cli/src/utils/sdk-event-handlers.ts.

eli5.text: When a specialized agent (like the researcher-web tool) finishes a task, your chat sometimes failed to show its final answer, leaving only partial progress visible inside the result box. Now, when such an agent returns its completed output, your chat checks whether that final content is longer than what was streamed during the run, and if so, it displays the final answer instead of the partial text. As a result, you will see the agent's finished summary appear in the box rather than getting cut off, which mainly affects people running these agent tools in the command-line chat.

ai.title: Release 1.0.580
ai.summary: This commit is a release bump to 1.0.580, packaging the prior day's and same-day work already merged to the cli package. Notable additions include `$VAR_NAME` env var resolution for MCP server configs via `resolveMcpEnv` in `sdk/src/agents/load-agents.ts` (replacing hardcoded tokens in `.agents/notion-agent.ts` and `.agents/notion-researcher.ts`), a new `@cli-ui-tester` agent plus `scripts/tmux/` helpers for automated CLI UI verification, PageUp/PageDown scrolling shortcuts in the CLI chat, correct Anthropic token counting for URL and base64 image parts in `web/src/app/api/v1/token-count/_post.ts`, a tmux-viewer TUI for session log inspection, and `allMessages`/`structuredOutput` handling in spawn agent result extraction. The sole change in this commit is the version string update in `cli/release/package.json`; the functional changes landed in preceding commits referenced by the release notes.
ai.evidence: The commit bumps the version in `cli/release/package.json` from 1.0.579 to 1.0.580 (`diff --git a/cli/release/package.json ... "version": "1.0.579" -> "version": "1.0.580"`), with no other file changes in this commit itself.

eli5.text: This release makes the AI assistant more reliable and easier to use every day. You can now connect to tools like Notion without pasting secret passwords directly into settings files. Instead, you reference secure environment variables that keep your tokens private and error-free. Chat history now scrolls smoothly with PageUp and PageDown keys, so you can navigate long conversations faster than ever. The assistant also fixes how it counts image tokens with Anthropic models, and improves how research agents return their final results, so answers come back complete instead of getting cut off. New testing tools help verify the interface works correctly, which means fewer glitches and better stability when you're working.
